name: GELU
tagline: Gaussian Error Linear Unit: smooth gating activation x * Phi(x) where Phi is the Gaussian CDF.
diff_from_baseline: Hendrycks & Gimpel 2016 (Gaussian Error Linear Units). Smooth, non-monotonic activation that allows small negative outputs; default in BERT, GPT-family, and many ViTs. Implemented via F.gelu.

name: Mish
tagline: Self-regularized non-monotonic activation x * tanh(softplus(x)) with smooth gradients.
diff_from_baseline: Misra 2019 (Mish: A Self Regularized Non-Monotonic Activation Function). Self-gated activation popular in YOLOv4 and other CV backbones; smooth, unbounded above, bounded below.

name: SiLU / Swish
tagline: Sigmoid Linear Unit: x * sigmoid(x). Self-gated, smooth, non-monotonic activation.
diff_from_baseline: Elfwing et al. 2017 / Ramachandran et al. 2017 (Searching for Activation Functions; also called Swish). Default activation in EfficientNet and many modern CNNs; implemented via F.silu.
